name: Lemon-Caper Spaghetti with Tofu, Asparagus, Bell Pepper & Parsley

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sprinkle each tofu plank with salt on both sides and sandwich between clean towels or paper towels; place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (340 g) pkg extra firm tofu
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes; drain and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp salt
142 g spaghetti pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small bunch asparagus
1 orange bell pepper
1 lemon
½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus; cut crosswise into 1-inch pieces and place in a small bowl.
Trim, seed, and slice bell pepper into thin strips; add to the bowl with the asparagus and set aside.
Cut the tofu planks in half, then cut each half into 2 triangles; place in a medium bowl. Sprinkle with flour and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp all-purpose flour
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add tofu and cook until golden, 2-3 minutes per side. Remove to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
When the tofu is done, return the skillet to medium heat; add more oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and additional flour; cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp all-purpose flour

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice half of the lemon into the skillet; add broth, capers, salt, and pepper. Cook, stirring often, until the sauce has thickened, 2-3 minutes. (Reserve remaining lemon for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
237 ml chicken or vegetable broth
2 tbsp capers
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the sauce is cooking, cut the remaining lemon into wedges and set aside for serving.
Add asparagus and bell pepper to the skillet with the sauce; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are fork-tender, about 4 minutes.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
When the veggies are done, add drained pasta and parsley to the skillet; toss to combine and continue to cook until heated through, 1-2 minutes more.
To serve, divide pasta, veggies, sauce, and tofu between plates or bowls. Squeeze lemon over top and enjoy!
